environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; action-driven composition; high-fidelity textures; no text.

visual_logic.composition: An organic game of peek-a-boo illustrating ecological protection. FOREGROUND CANOPY: A dense, vertical thicket of golden-brown Sargassum-like algae and trailing crinoid anchors fills the center-left frame. Peeking out from behind the thick strands are several small, highly expressive primitive belemnites and tiny fish, coverage-shielded as they playfully mock the larger animals. BACKGROUND UPPER RIGHT: Two large, beautifully rendered Stenopterygius marine reptiles swim by in a sleek, horizontal profile. They are squinting their eyes and scanning the open water, completely oblivious to the common prey hiding just inches away in the safety of the protective flora structure.
visual_logic.ground: Flat, jet-black bituminous mud floor scattered with beautifully patterned, hollow ammonite shells.
visual_logic.background: Deep indigo-to-black water columns creating an atmospheric perspective that isolates the warm tones of the algae.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright afternoon surface light filtering weakly downwards through the floating crinoid rafts, casting soft, dappled golden highlights and long patterns across the hiding prey.
